lines: 「Gufuu, she's strong......! For Sakura Blossom's attacks not to get through at all......」
Lena and the female soldiers from Nomad had been slammed against the muddy ground of Yomihara.
Her swordsmanship and the female soldiers' attacks had been completely neutralized by the Hellfire shield that Astaroth created.
「I thought you had a little promise, but you were a real let-down.」
「S...... Strange. The tip said the terrorists were weak......」
Lena bemoaned, as she fell flat on the ground. The female soldiers, who had only just barely survived, retreated, dragging her along.
Making sure that their figures had gone away, the refugee brothers, who had been hiding, timidly poked their faces out.
「Wh-Whadda we do......? We've even got Hell Knights setting their sights on us?」
「What are you saying, at this point? You fellows sure are faint of heart, considering you want to destroy this entire town. It's all going to burn, so it makes no difference, does it?♪」
At that point, the older brother noticed something, and forcibly pushed his younger brother and Astaroth behind cover.
While holding her back with a hushed voice, he pointed towards the plaza.
「You really are hopeless. But on that point, I'm thankful that Hebiko-chan and Shikanosuke-kun always listen so enthusiastically to my lessons.」
「Heh heh! That's 'cause Kousaka-sensei's lessons are super easy to understand!」
「Fuuma-chan, you have to make sure to attend your classes, you know?」
「Ufufu. See?☆ Your friends are saying so too, Fuuma-kun.」
Ahead of where the older brother pointed were boys and a girl, who were out of place in Yomihara, as well as a captivatingly beautiful woman.
They were talking on and on with smiling faces for some reason.
The men peeked at that from the shadows and stealthily lowered their voices.
「They're a really dangerous bunch, who make hunting demons their raison d'être.」
「Them? They're a woman and children, aren't they?」
The woman aside, to all appearances, the boys and girl were just scrawny children.
「No no no! They use some magic we don't really understand, so you can't judge them by their appearance!」
「Basically, when it comes to being strong, they're way more dangerous than that Hell Knight from before.」
Astaroth narrowed her eyes as she stared at the group, but her gaze suddenly stopped on the young man who was at the back.
It looked like he was being playfully teased, getting poked by the woman and laughed at by the boy, but on the other hand, for some reason, he seemed to stand out from his surroundings.
There was something out-of-place, almost distorted, so slight that even a great demon of her calibre wouldn't notice unless she stared at it intently.
Figuring that Astaroth, who stared fixedly at him, had taken an interest in the Taimanin, the brothers hurried to try and dissuade her.
「D-Don't tell me you're thinking of fighting Taimanin?」
「Please stop! If we make enemies of the Taimanin too, on top of all this......」
「You're right. I'll give it a pass.」
Simply saying that, she took her eyes off the Taimanin, and turned on her heel.
（But...... Oh well. It looks like it's still too early for that right now.）
Astaroth smiled to herself, and quietly left the commotion behind with the armed refugees.
